quests.name: The Defias Brotherhood
objectives: Speak with Wiley the Black at the Lakeshire Inn in Redridge Mountains.
quests.summary: Opening step of the iconic Westfall Defias Brotherhood chain starting from Gryan Stoutmantle at Sentinel Hill (56.2, 47.6).

quests.name: The Defias Brotherhood
objectives: Escort the Defias Traitor from Sentinel Hill to Moonbrook to discover the Deadmines entrance.
quests.summary: Escort quest in Westfall where the Defias Traitor leads players to the secret Moonbrook barn entrance of The Deadmines.

quests.name: The Defias Brotherhood
objectives: Kill Edwin VanCleef inside The Deadmines and bring the Head of VanCleef to Gryan Stoutmantle.
quests.summary: Finale of The Defias Brotherhood chain: enter The Deadmines in Westfall, defeat Edwin VanCleef, and return to Gryan Stoutmantle (56.2, 47.6).

quests.name: Wanted: "Hogger"
objectives: Slay Hogger (Elite Lvl 11) in southwestern Elwynn Forest around (26.2, 92.3) and bring Huge Gnoll Claw to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.
quests.summary: Group quest in Elwynn Forest picked up from the Wanted Poster (24.6, 74.7); Hogger spawns at (26.2, 92.3) and turns in to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire (42.1, 65.9).

quests.name: Test of Faith
objectives: Jump off the high cliff platform at The Weathered Nook (54.0, 41.5) in Thousand Needles to prove your faith.
quests.summary: Horde quest in Thousand Needles from Dorn Plainstalker at The Weathered Nook (54.0, 41.5), leading into Test of Endurance (1150).

quests.name: Lost in Battle
objectives: Find Mankrik's Wife (Beaten Corpse) in The Barrens at (49.3, 50.4) in a small hut north of Camp Taurajo and east of the Gold Road.
quests.summary: Horde quest from Mankrik at The Crossroads (52.1, 31.6) in The Barrens. The Beaten Corpse (Mankrik's Wife) lies at (49.3, 50.4).

quests.name: The Great Masquerade
objectives: Escort Reginald Windsor through Stormwind Keep to unmask Lady Katrana Prestor and speak with Highlord Bolvar Fordragon (80.2, 38.3).
quests.summary: Key Stormwind City event in the Alliance Onyxia's Lair attunement chain, turning in to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon at (80.2, 38.3).

quests.name: Drakefire Amulet
objectives: Defeat General Drakkisath in Upper Blackrock Spire and bring the Blood of the Black Dragon Champion to Haleh at Mazthoril in Winterspring (54.4, 51.1).
quests.summary: Final step of Alliance Onyxia's Lair attunement: loot Blood of the Black Dragon Champion from General Drakkisath in UBRS and return to Haleh in Winterspring (54.4, 51.1) for Drakefire Amulet.

quests.name: Blood of the Black Dragon Champion
objectives: Slay General Drakkisath in Upper Blackrock Spire, collect Blood of the Black Dragon Champion, and return to Rexxar (Desolace/Feralas patrol) / Rokaro in Orgrimmar for Drakefire Amulet.
aliases: Sangue del Campione dei Draghi Neri
quests.summary: Final step of the Horde Onyxia's Lair attunement chain rewarding Drakefire Amulet (item=16309) after defeating General Drakkisath in UBRS.

quests.name: Attunement to the Core
objectives: Enter Blackrock Depths, loot a Core Fragment near the Molten Core portal bridge, and return to Lothos Riftwaker in the Blackrock Mountain chain alcove.
quests.summary: Grants direct teleportation into Molten Core via Lothos Riftwaker in Blackrock Mountain (approx. 31.1, 30.1 Burning Steppes exterior / 26.4, 24.5 Searing Gorge exterior) after looting Core Fragment in BRD.

quests.name: Thunderaan the Windseeker
objectives: Bring Left & Right Bindings of the Windseeker (from Garr and Baron Geddon in Molten Core), 10 Enchanted Elementium Bars, and Essence of the Firelord (from Ragnaros) to summon and defeat Prince Thunderaan in Silithus.

rewards.item_name: Thunderfury, Blessed Blade of the Windseeker

quests.summary: Legendary quest in northwestern Silithus (29.6, 10.6) culminating in summoning Prince Thunderaan and earning Thunderfury, Blessed Blade of the Windseeker.
